title: Yellowed Chewy Croatian Shallots Stew
description: A peppery and chewy Croatian dish featuring shallots, perfect for a lazy Sunday, cooked in a dolsot stone bowl with steam, and low in sodium.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the dolsot stone bowl over medium heat.
Add the sliced shallots and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the paprika, black pepper, and dried thyme, and stir to combine.
Pour in the low-sodium chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, until the shallots are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
